claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime.bonus_action_post_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Smite is a Bonus Action taken immediately after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The existing CastingTime.bonus_action carries no condition field, so the post-hit constraint is unrepresentable. This constraint is mechanically load-bearing: it prevents casting Divine Smite except as a rider on a successful melee hit in the same turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "1 Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.direct_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Smite delivers damage to the already-hit target without making its own attack roll or requesting a saving throw. ActivationPhase is currently 'attack_roll | save_gate'; neither is honest here. A 'direct_damage' phase kind is needed: attachment + effect, no resolution check of its own.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount or Effect conditional_by_creature_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The base damage expression gains +1d8 when the target is a Fiend or Undead. No existing DiceAmount variant supports predicated bonuses keyed on target creature type. This requires either a new DiceAmount kind or a wrapper on DamageEffect carrying a conditional bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead."
